# SHIP-001 Shipping and delays

Standard shipping takes 5 business days. For an order whose recorded status is delayed,
contact the carrier first. If the carrier cannot resolve it, follow ESCALATE-001.
An estimated delivery date is not proof of delivery; use the recorded delivered_on date.
